# Metagraphed — Repo Structure Map (Miner Guide)

> Cập nhật lần cuối: 2026-07-22. Chạy `./update.sh` để pull code mới và kiểm tra docs có lỗi thời không.

Bittensor subnet integration registry (Cloudflare Worker API + Node build scripts, schema-first: JSON Schema → OpenAPI → typed clients).

**Labels:** `gittensor:priority`=1.5 · `gittensor:feature`=0.25 · `gittensor:bug`=0.05 · `slop`=0
**Review:** one-shot merge-or-close (KHÔNG có changes-requested) · max **2 open PR** · mọi PR phải link 1 issue đang mở (issue do maintainer tạo — chọn từ `good first issue` / `help wanted`).
**Setup:** Node 22 (`.nvmrc`) · `npm install` · nên dùng devcontainer.

---

## 1. Directory tree (2 levels)

```
metagraphed/
├── registry/                 # ★ Curated source data — nơi miner đóng góp chính (Path A)
│   ├── subnets/              # 1 file JSON / subnet: registry/subnets/<slug>.json
│   ├── providers/            # Provider identity stubs
│   ├── candidates/           # Machine-only (lane community/ ĐÃ BỎ — CI reject nếu tái tạo)
│   ├── adapters/ native/ reviews/ verification/ generated/
├── schemas/                  # ★ SOURCE OF TRUTH cho API contract (JSON Schema)
│   ├── components/           # Schema fragments đánh số
│   └── ai/                   # AI route schemas
├── scripts/                  # npm run * implementations (validate, build, surface:add…)
├── workers/                  # Cloudflare Worker API entrypoints (api.mjs = router)
│   └── request-handlers/
├── public/metagraph/         # Generated contracts ĐÃ COMMIT (openapi, types…)
├── generated/                # Generated TS client (metagraphed-client.ts)
├── apps/
│   ├── ui/                   # Frontend metagraph.sh (workspace riêng — Path C)
│   └── indexer-rs/           # Rust chain indexer
├── src/                      # Worker/backend domain logic
├── tests/                    # Vitest suite
├── packages/                 # client/ (JS SDK), contract/ (types), ui-kit/
├── python/                   # Python SDK
├── migrations/               # D1/Postgres migration SQL
└── docs/                     # ADRs, curation playbook
```

---

## 2. Community-submission flow (Path A — PR đầu tiên tốt nhất)

**Nguyên tắc: 1 subnet = 1 file = 1 PR.** Chỉ sửa `registry/subnets/<slug>.json`, append surface vào `surfaces[]`. KHÔNG commit generated artifacts, KHÔNG sửa metadata top-level của manifest có sẵn.

### Surface object mà `surface:add` ghi ra

```jsonc
{
  "id": "sn-43-example-subnet-api",
  "name": "Example subnet API",
  "kind": "subnet-api",
  "url": "https://api.example.com/v1",
  "provider": "example",
  "authority": "community",
  "auth_required": false,
  "public_safe": true,
  "source_urls": ["https://github.com/example/project/blob/main/README.md"],
  "review": { "state": "community-submitted", "submitted_by": "<github-login>" }
}
```

- **Không bao giờ** tự set `verification`/health/uptime — prober của build sở hữu.
- Kind auto-review: `docs`, `website`, `source-repo`, `dashboard`, `openapi`, `subnet-api`, `sse`, `data-artifact`, `sdk`, `example`. **Ưu tiên kind callable** (`openapi`, `subnet-api`, `sse`, `data-artifact`, `sdk`) — `website`/`source-repo` hay bị dedupe với on-chain identity → reject.
- `subtensor-rpc`/`subtensor-wss`/`archive` = maintainer lane, không phải của contributor.

### Lệnh

```bash
npm run providers:list                              # 1) tìm provider slug
npm run subnet:new -- --netuid <n> --name "<Real Name>" --write   # 2a) nếu chưa có file (tên thật, không placeholder)
npm run surface:add -- \
  --netuid <n> --kind docs \
  --url https://docs.example.com \
  --source-url https://github.com/example/project \
  --provider <slug> --submitted-by <github-login> --write         # 2b) append surface
npm run validate:surface -- registry/subnets/<slug>.json          # 3) pre-check local
```

Tìm việc: `npm run curation:brief` · epic surface-enrichment **#427**.

### CI validate gì

Workflow `.github/workflows/validate.yml`: build → test:ci → ~20 validators (registry, schemas, api, openapi, surface, public-safety, private-boundary, worker dry-runs). Sau CI, **Gittensory Gate** one-shot merge/close/hold. Fail tất định (duplicate, `source_url` chết, private URL, secrets, CI đỏ, issue thiếu/đóng) → **close ngay**.

---

## 3. Schema-first rule (Path B — code/schema)

1. Sửa **`schemas/`** (+ `src/contracts.mjs`/workers nếu cần) — không bao giờ hand-edit OpenAPI/types.
2. Chạy **`npm run build`**.
3. **Commit artifacts regenerated trong cùng PR**, gồm: `schemas/api-components.schema.json`, `public/metagraph/openapi.json`, `public/metagraph/types.d.ts`, `packages/contract/index.d.ts`, `generated/metagraphed-client.ts`.

`validate:contract-drift` fail = bạn đổi source mà chưa rebuild/commit, hoặc hand-edit generated file.

**KHÔNG commit** (deploy-owned): `public/metagraph/r2-manifest.json`, `public/metagraph/schemas/index.json`, version bump của `packages/client`/MCP (automation tự bump — tự bump sẽ bị close).

---

## 4. Validation gates

| Command | Covers |
|---|---|
| `npm test` | Full Vitest suite |
| `npm run validate` | Registry/data integrity |
| `npm run validate:schemas` | Ajv: schemas + registry + artifacts |
| `npm run validate:api` | Worker routes vs OpenAPI/envelopes |
| `npm run validate:openapi` | OpenAPI 3.1 structural checks |
| `npm run worker:test` | Worker smoke (cần `npm run build` trước) |
| `npm run pipeline:check` | Full local gate chain |
| `validate:surface` / `scan:public-safety` | Path A minimum |
| `test:coverage` | CI patch coverage **99%** trên `src/**` + `workers/**` |

Shorthand: `npm install && npm test && npm run validate && npm run build`

---

## 5. Guarded vs auto-reviewable paths (`.loopover.yml`)

**Auto-review** (PR chỉ đụng những đường này): `registry/subnets/**`, `registry/providers/**`, `registry/reviews/**`, `registry/adapters/**`.

**Manual review** (đụng bất kỳ cái nào): `scripts/**`, `workers/**`, `.github/**`, `schemas/**`, `src/**`, `tests/**`, `migrations/**`, `packages/**`, `public/**`, `apps/**`, root files. Visual UI PRs luôn manual.

**Không trộn Path A + B + C trong 1 PR.**

---

## 6. apps/ui (Path C)

- Workspace riêng: `npm run dev --workspace=apps/ui`; build/lint/test/e2e đều qua `--workspace=apps/ui`.
- **PR đổi visual bắt buộc** bảng screenshot before/after trong PR body (hosted image): mobile 375×812, tablet 768×1024, desktop 1280×800, cả 2 theme. Helper: `apps/ui/tests/e2e/capture-pr-screenshots.mjs`.
- Không sửa `vite.config.ts` / Nitro preset (Lovable-managed). Aim ≤10 files / ≤1000 LOC.

---

## Checklist trước khi mở PR (Path A)

- [ ] Link issue đang mở (`good first issue` / `help wanted` / #427)
- [ ] Đang có ≤ 1 PR mở khác (cap = 2)
- [ ] Chỉ đụng 1 file `registry/subnets/<slug>.json` (+ provider debut nếu có)
- [ ] `authority: community` + `review.state: community-submitted`
- [ ] `url` public + `source_url` chứng minh được; kind thuộc nhóm auto-review
- [ ] `npm run validate:surface` xanh
- [ ] Title Conventional Commit; không AI attribution; không secrets/private URL

**Nhớ:** bị close = mất credibility (gate 0.5). Chỉ nộp khi chắc chắn xanh. Không giục review (bị +5 ngày queue).

Surfaces live in **one file per subnet**: `registry/subnets/<slug>.json` → its `surfaces[]` array. A community contribution **adds a surface to that one file** — `npm run surface:add` writes it with `authority: "community"` and `review.state: "community-submitted"`. If the subnet has no manifest yet, scaffold that one subnet file first with `npm run subnet:new`, then add the surface to the same file. There is no per-surface candidate file anymore (recreating `registry/candidates/community/*.json` is rejected by CI), so you can't farm one surface per PR: **one subnet = one file = one PR.**

**Higher-trust application surfaces** (authenticated or paid APIs, unknown providers, identity disputes) are welcome too — the autonomous reviewer scrutinizes identity/evidence harder and, when in doubt, closes or escalates rather than merging. Make the proof airtight (an independent `source_url` proving ownership).
